bibl.title: The Demades Papyrus (P.Berol. inv. 13045)
bibl.seg: Davide Amendola, The Demades Papyrus (P.Berol. inv. 13045). A New Text with Commentary = Sozomena. 17.
Berlin - New York, W. de Gruyter, 2022, xiv-598 pp., figg. ISBN 978-3-11-060091-9. €123,95.
bibl.note: P. Berol. Inv. 13045 (= MP3 2102; 2570 = LDAB 6760). - Introduction: 1. The papyrus; - 2. The origin, nature and purpose of the contents of the papyrus; - 3. The papyrus' contribution in historical and historiographical terms. - Edition and translation: Siglorum et compendiorum explicatio; - Editorial Note; - A eulogy of the Lagid monarchy (P.Berol. inv. 13045, cols. A I–III); - The dialogue between Demades and Dinarchus at the Macedonian court (P.Berol. inv. 13045, cols. B I–G III). - Commentary: A eulogy of the Ptolemaic monarchy (P.Berol. inv. 13045, cols. A I–III); - The dialogue between Demades and Dinarchus at the Macedonian court. - Appendix: Demadis testimonia et fragmenta: conspectus numerorum. - Bibliography. Indexes.
